name: Alpine 2-person tent
blurb: Two doors, two vestibules, and a frame that shrugs off spring storms.

name: Ridge 40 L pack
blurb: A frame that carries 15 kg like 10, with a lid that actually closes.

name: Trail mug
blurb: Double-walled steel. Coffee stays hot through the first switchback.

name: Camp lantern
blurb: Warm light for the whole tent, and a USB-C port to charge your phone.

name: Fieldbook compass
blurb: Liquid-damped needle and a mirror for sighting distant peaks.

name: Topo map set
blurb: Waterproof 1:25,000 sheets for the three most-walked ranges.

name: Ember stove
blurb: Boils a litre in three minutes and folds smaller than your fist.

name: Dry bag, 20 L
blurb: Roll-top, welded seams. Your sleeping bag stays dry in the canoe.

name: Glacier sunglasses
blurb: Category 4 lenses and side shields for snow and high altitude.

name: Storm umbrella
blurb: Vented canopy that stays the right way out in a 60 km/h gust.

name: 800-fill down jacket
blurb: Warm at minus ten, packs into its own pocket.

name: Summit binoculars 8x32
blurb: Bright, light, and sharp to the edges. Spot the next cairn first.
